approval_ref: Continue improving CIRP efficiency, accuracy and adaptability across RFI, Submittal and Email content.
notes: Reuse the complete workflow index to select one exact Submittal primary source.
Recognize only bounded English Spec Section, Description and Review Comments requests.
Require an explicit supported field label inside exact Submittal-scoped evidence.
Allow multiline values in one immutable passage and current Email-body scopes.
Exclude unlabeled text, quoted Email history and vision narration.
Fail closed for conflicting values, multiple primary sources or more than 32 candidate passages.
Use synthetic evidence and make no provider or mailbox request.
title: Answer explicit Submittal fields locally
objective: Return unambiguous explicit Submittal fields from existing local evidence without model cost.
